details:
Project Title: Astronaut Health Monitoring Software

Tagline: "See the risk before the mission feels it"

> Project Overview & Functionality:

> We developed the "Astronaut Health Monitoring Software" under the tagline "See the risk before the mission feels it." The project functions as a lightweight telemetry and diagnostic web tool designed to track real-time crew stability and flag early warning health indicators during space missions.

> How It Works & Development Tools:

> The software features a robust backend built using Python and Flask, coupled with a clean layout and presentation structure built via Gamma. It bridges raw telemetry data with proactive monitoring to analyze physiological trends before physical symptoms manifest.

> Benefits & Intended Impact:

> The primary impact is safeguarding astronaut well-being and mitigating physiological hazards in deep-space environments. By offering early risk detection, the software optimizes mission success, protects human health, and provides a scalable framework for continuous crew monitoring.

> Creativity & Considerations:

> Our approach focuses on proactive prevention rather than reactive treatment. Key design factors included ease of deployment, lightweight web architecture, and a strong emphasis on critical life-support metrics.
